judgement.reason: AnythingLLM keeps its core data on local disk: a SQLite database through Prisma, plus document storage and a built-in vector store, and the files shown do not prove a PostgreSQL or MySQL option exists, which Deployz's stateless containers need.

evidence.quote: Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines — no extra configuration required.
